sourceEnglishTitle: Read the Manufacturer Sheet Before the Flashing Goes On
sourceEnglishObjective: Read a manufacturer instruction sheet, find the key specs, and explain the steps to the crew
sourceEnglishSpeaking: You are the crew lead and the AI is a crew member ready to install flashing from habit: read the key steps of the manufacturer sheet aloud, explain what has to happen before and after each step, and get agreement to follow the sheet.

sourceGrammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que

examples.es: Antes de instalar el tapajuntas, hay que leer la hoja.
examples.en: Before installing the flashing, you have to read the sheet.

examples.es: Después de leer cada paso, tenemos que revisar el material.
examples.en: After reading each step, we have to check the material.

example.target: Rogelio lee en voz alta el paso 1 de las instrucciones del fabricante.
example.native: Rogelio reads step 1 of the manufacturer instructions out loud.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite: leí, leyó (i changes to y between vowels).

example.target: Antes de instalar, hay que leer la hoja.
example.native: Before installing, you have to read the sheet.

sourceVerbExamples.note: After antes de or después de, use the infinitive: antes de instalar.

example.target: Rogelio coloca una pieza de tapajuntas escalonado en cada hilera.
example.native: Rogelio places one piece of step flashing on each course.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Usted command in written instructions: coloque (c changes to qu).

example.target: Fije cada pieza solo a la cubierta.
example.native: Fasten each piece only to the deck.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Usted command in written instructions: fije.

example.target: Si no sigue estos pasos, el producto puede fallar.
example.native: If you do not follow these steps, the product may fail.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Stem change e to i, and the yo form is sigo.

candidateObjective: メーカーの施工仕様書から主要条件を読み取り、作業班に手順を説明する。
candidateFocus: ～前に orders reading before installation. ～に従って ties work to the specification; ～ではなく contrasts the written sheet with habit.

archivedSpeaking.opening: まずメーカーの施工仕様書を読みましょう。各段に一枚ずつ段差水切りを取り付け、仕様書の最小重ね幅と指定固定具を確認してください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Read the relevant manufacturer instructions before installing flashing. Explain the order, specified fasteners and overlap, and confirm that the crew will follow the sheet.

cards.sourceSpanish: Antes de instalar, hay que leer la hoja.

cards.sourceEnglish: Could you give me a moment, please?

reader.sourceSpanish: Antes de poner el tapajuntas escalonado en la pared lateral, Rogelio saca la hoja técnica de la caja.
reader.sourceEnglish: Before putting the step flashing on the sidewall, Rogelio takes the spec sheet out of the box.
reader.candidateJapanese: 外壁際に段差水切りを取り付ける前に、ロヘリオは箱から施工仕様書を取り出します。
reader.archivedJapanese: 外壁際に段差水切りを取り付ける前に、ロヘリオは箱から施工仕様書を取り出します。
reader.archivedEnglish: Before putting the step flashing on the sidewall, Rogelio takes the spec sheet out of the box.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Antes de instalar, hay que leer la hoja, aunque llevemos años haciendo esto.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Before installing, you have to read the sheet, even if we've been doing this for years.
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「長年この作業をしていても、施工する前に仕様書を読まなければなりません。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「長年この作業をしていても、施工する前に仕様書を読まなければなりません。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Before installing, you have to read the sheet, even if we've been doing this for years.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: La hoja manda, no la costumbre.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: The sheet rules, not habit.
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「習慣ではなく仕様書に従います。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「習慣ではなく仕様書に従います。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: The sheet rules, not habit.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio lee en voz alta el paso 1 de las instrucciones del fabricante.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio reads step 1 of the manufacturer instructions out loud.
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオはメーカーの施工説明書の手順一を声に出して読みます。
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオはメーカーの施工説明書の手順一を声に出して読みます。
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio reads step 1 of the manufacturer instructions out loud.

reader.sourceSpanish: Paso 1: Antes de colocar el tapajuntas, instale la sub-capa sobre la cubierta y súbala por la pared lateral según la especificación.
reader.sourceEnglish: Step 1: Before placing the flashing, install the underlayment over the deck and run it up the sidewall according to the specification.
reader.archivedJapanese: 手順一「水切り板金を取り付ける前に、仕様に従って野地板の上に下葺き材を敷き、外壁際まで立ち上げます。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Step 1: Before placing the flashing, install the underlayment over the deck and run it up the sidewall according to the specification.
reader.reviewNote: This fictional sheet specifies underlayment and sidewall turn-up; do not generalize to all products.

reader.sourceSpanish: Paso 2: Coloque una pieza de tapajuntas escalonado en cada hilera, con el traslape mínimo que indica esta hoja.
reader.sourceEnglish: Step 2: Place one piece of step flashing on each course, with the minimum overlap this sheet indicates.
reader.archivedJapanese: 手順二「各段に段差水切りを一枚ずつ取り付け、この仕様書に示された最小重ね幅を守ります。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Step 2: Place one piece of step flashing on each course, with the minimum overlap this sheet indicates.
reader.reviewNote: One piece per course and minimum overlap depend on actual product sheet.

reader.sourceSpanish: Paso 3: Fije cada pieza solo a la cubierta, nunca a la pared, con el sujetador indicado.
reader.sourceEnglish: Step 3: Fasten each piece only to the deck, never to the wall, with the specified fastener.
reader.archivedJapanese: 手順三「指定された固定具を使い、各部材を壁ではなく野地板にのみ固定します。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Step 3: Fasten each piece only to the deck, never to the wall, with the specified fastener.
reader.reviewNote: Deck-only fastening is a product-specific instruction; confirm system and approved attachment.

reader.sourceSpanish: Paso 4: Después de colocar el tapajuntas, el revestimiento de pared debe cubrirlo; no use sellador en lugar de tapajuntas.
reader.sourceEnglish: Step 4: After placing the flashing, the siding must cover it; do not use sealant instead of flashing.
reader.archivedJapanese: 手順四「水切り板金を取り付けた後、外壁材で覆います。水切り板金の代わりにシーリング材を使わないでください。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Step 4: After placing the flashing, the siding must cover it; do not use sealant instead of flashing.
reader.reviewNote: Siding coverage and sealant prohibition are product-specific details.

reader.sourceSpanish: Advertencia: Si no sigue estos pasos, el producto puede fallar y el fabricante puede no cubrir el daño.
reader.sourceEnglish: Warning: If you do not follow these steps, the product may fail and the manufacturer may not cover the damage.
reader.archivedJapanese: 警告「この手順に従わないと製品が機能せず、メーカーが損害を補償しない場合があります。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Warning: If you do not follow these steps, the product may fail and the manufacturer may not cover the damage.
reader.reviewNote: Warranty consequence depends on actual manufacturer terms.

reader.sourceSpanish: Kevin: Oye, ¿tú ya lo leíste todo?
reader.sourceEnglish: Kevin: Hey, have you already read all of it?
reader.candidateJapanese: ケビン「ねえ、もう全部読みましたか。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ケビン「ねえ、もう全部読みましたか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Kevin: Hey, have you already read all of it?

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Sí, y tú también tienes que leerlo; no lo hagas de memoria.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Yes, and you have to read it too; don't do it from memory.
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「はい。あなたも読んでください。記憶だけで施工しないでください。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「はい。あなたも読んでください。記憶だけで施工しないでください。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Yes, and you have to read it too; don't do it from memory.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Después de leer cada paso, hay que revisar si el material del camión es el mismo de la hoja.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: After reading each step, you have to check whether the material on the truck is the same as on the sheet.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「各手順を読んだ後、トラックの資材が仕様書のものと同じか確認します。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: After reading each step, you have to check whether the material on the truck is the same as on the sheet.
reader.reviewNote: Material matching must follow actual product sheet.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: ¿Qué dice la hoja sobre el traslape?
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: What does the sheet say about the overlap?
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「重ね幅について仕様書には何と書いてありますか。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「重ね幅について仕様書には何と書いてありますか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: What does the sheet say about the overlap?

reader.sourceSpanish: Kevin: Dice que hay que usar el traslape mínimo de la hoja, y que la chimenea y el tapajuntas para tubo tienen otra sección.
reader.sourceEnglish: Kevin: It says you have to use the sheet's minimum overlap, and that the chimney and the pipe boot have another section.
reader.archivedJapanese: ケビン「仕様書の最小重ね幅を使うと書いてあります。煙突と配管貫通部用ブーツには別の項目があります。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Kevin: It says you have to use the sheet's minimum overlap, and that the chimney and the pipe boot have another section.
reader.reviewNote: Chimney and pipe-boot sections are fictional sheet references.

reader.sourceSpanish: Luego el dueño de la casa pregunta cuándo empiezan, y Rogelio contesta: ¿Me permite un momento, por favor?
reader.sourceEnglish: Then the homeowner asks when they're starting, and Rogelio answers: Could you give me a moment, please?
reader.candidateJapanese: その後、家主が作業開始時刻を尋ね、ロヘリオは「少々お時間をいただけますか」と答えます。
reader.archivedJapanese: その後、家主が作業開始時刻を尋ね、ロヘリオは「少々お時間をいただけますか」と答えます。
reader.archivedEnglish: Then the homeowner asks when they're starting, and Rogelio answers: Could you give me a moment, please?

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Así lo pide el fabricante, y así lo hacemos.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: That's what the manufacturer asks for, and that's how we do it.
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「それがメーカーの指定です。そのとおりに施工します。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「それがメーカーの指定です。そのとおりに施工します。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: That's what the manufacturer asks for, and that's how we do it.

see.label: Find the spec sheet, step flashing, sidewall, and pipe boot.

recall.label: Recall minimum overlap, specified fastener, siding, and sealant.

hear.label: Distinguish 最小重ね幅 from 固定具 when spoken.

type.label: Type 'The sheet rules, not habit' in Japanese.

say.label: Read the manufacturer sheet and explain its four steps to the crew.

write.label: Write what material is checked against the sheet before installation.

curriculumAdaptationNote: The lesson describes a fictional manufacturer sheet, with underlayment, step flashing, fastening, siding and warranty sequence. Preserve every exact source step but do not present its product-specific details as universal installation advice. No actual manufacturer document or specifications are supplied, so qualified product/roofing and Japanese review must resolve selected instructions. Grammar and five Spanish verbs are pinned separately. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.
